open_points.subject: TrialExecution file outputs
open_points.text: State 4 says module:functions "stores the outputs through capability:store.put_value_bytes", while M07 says that for a file output it keeps "only its facts — digest, size and media type, no bytes and never a StoredValue" and K-10 permits only trial-case file fixtures to persist beyond a run.
open_points.question: After a trial or admission execution produces a file, are its bytes discarded after recording the facts, or persisted in the content-addressed area despite M07 and K-10?
options: Discard the bytes and record only digest, size and media type
Persist the bytes as a StoredValue
Persist them as a trial fixture
open_points.default_guess: Discard the bytes after recording digest, size and media type.

open_points.subject: Refused captured trial case
open_points.text: State 3 says "runs copies a spooled file into the content-addressed area only after every check of the capture has passed" and "a refused capture copies nothing"; State 4 instead says it copies the files before module:functions checks fit and size, and that "files copied before module:functions refuses the case stay in the content-addressed area, named by no record".
open_points.question: Must all capture validation finish before file bytes are copied, or may a refused capture leave unreferenced persistent bytes?
options: Validate everything first and copy nothing on refusal
Copy first and retain unreferenced bytes on refusal
Copy first but remove the bytes if the case is refused
open_points.default_guess: Validate every capture condition before copying any file bytes.

open_points.subject: Crash after spooling an output but before writing its NodeExecution
open_points.text: State 3 says "A file spooled before its record is written" and State 4 places capability:store.spool_file before the store call that writes the concluding NodeExecution, but startup recovery removes only temporary files and whole spools of ended runs; no step or capability removes a successfully published file belonging to an unconcluded function, read, or effect attempt.
open_points.question: What happens to files already published in an active run's spool when the process crashes before the attempt's concluding record is written?
options: Recovery detects and removes files not referenced by a concluded NodeExecution
Files remain and count toward the run's spool ceilings
Spooling remains staged until the concluding record atomically publishes it
open_points.default_guess: Recovery removes spool files not referenced by a concluded NodeExecution before retrying the element.

open_points.subject: Installed-instance startup check
open_points.text: capability:bindings.check_installed_instances "reads only the installation and the manifest" to inspect required headers, but the listed startup errors state only "a credential header colliding with a required header or a kernel-set header" and do not state what happens when the selected service record, selected instance, or manifest data needed by this check is absent, unreadable or malformed.
open_points.question: During startup, what result does check_installed_instances produce when it cannot obtain a selected instance's required-header data from the manifest?
options: Stop startup with a manifest or instance error
Skip that service and let proposal or invocation fail later
Treat the instance as having no required headers
open_points.default_guess: Stop startup and name the manifest or selected-instance failure.
